research_question: Do Shorts cause viewers to continue to related ordinary videos, and what cost and earned value could be measured?
population: YouTube Shorts viewers exposed to creators' linked videos and eligible owners, with no sampled channel cohort
method: Document the official linked-video mechanism, distinguish observable format summaries from directly linked events, and prespecify a comparison with a complete paid and labor-cost ledger.
feature_rules: Related-video selection uses a video/Short/Live from the same channel and links within the Shorts player.
Advanced feature access is required; selected related video must be public or unlisted and follow Community Guidelines.
A related-video link is not a guaranteed recommendation or proof of exposure to each Shorts viewer.
Creator-access Studio reports are not a public dataset of per-Short onward clicks.
Ordinary video view events, Shorts engaged views and unique people are different counting units, especially around the August 24 2026 revision.

identifiability_gates.required: Verified advanced features, link destination and effective release period
Authorized source-specific referral events connected to the named Short and destination, with documented source mechanism
Numerator and denominator in compatible event units, same metric epoch, disjoint populations or documented repeats
Prerecorded randomized or sufficiently controlled comparison rather than unrelated before/after video totals
Documented creator hours and cash for both source Short and destination video, adjusted for other traffic

example_refusal_cases.input: one Short has 1000 views and destination video has 200 views
example_refusal_cases.reason: No verified link exposure, clicks or attributed destination events

example_refusal_cases.input: 500 Shorts viewers also watch an ordinary video
example_refusal_cases.reason: Undirected viewer overlap does not establish sequence or origin

example_refusal_cases.input: video receives 50 extra views after link creation
example_refusal_cases.reason: No control for recommendations, direct visits, temporal/seasonal changes or other traffic
